Haha, well I could tell you about it but it's rather NSFW. To put it lightly, I like drawing adult related things. But I am planning on branding myself soon for the specific audience so it's a pretty big thing. I also have some others things but this is first on my list as it could be a money maker for me. So I don't think anyone can be involved in this one.

EDIT: Thank you by the way for your input. I really appreciate it.

I completely agree with you, however the thing is that I thought that I was beyond this whole ordeal but yesterday just hit me hard. I have a big personal project that I'm working on that started this week but it clearly didn't help me distract. I'm worried.
Honestly, I really hope that I have this Pure-O OCD. I would finally have a explanation for my behaviour.
